beats.title: Choose the interface
beats.narration: Start with the kind of interface you're building. Here, we'll switch from a product app to a creative experience.

beats.title: Make it fit the audience
beats.narration: Now choose the audience. A personal portfolio calls for a more expressive approach, and the recommended route changes with it.

beats.title: See what the route requires
beats.narration: The guide puts the recommended skills beside the tools it lists as available, with substitutions shown underneath. You can see what the route still needs.
